themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, collaborate, and execute complex workflows with minimal human intervention.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools that assist developers in writing, reviewing, debugging, and testing code, acting as intelligent coding partners.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Explores the behavior, capabilities, risks, and user interactions with AI chatbots, including their conversational abilities and potential biases.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses a broad range of AI-powered tools designed to aid researchers in various aspects of their work, from data analysis to literature review.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Investigates how AI is being used to assist in the design process, including UI/UX creation, prototyping, and generating design assets.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Analyzes the effects of AI on jobs, employment, and the skills required in the workforce, including automation risks and new job creation.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Details AI applications that condense large amounts of text, data, or conversations into concise summaries and key insights.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Focuses on the assessment, comparison, and benchmarking of various AI tools and platforms for specific applications and industries.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Covers the use of AI-generated personas or data that mimic real users for testing, research, and analysis purposes.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Examines how AI is utilized to gather, analyze, and interpret customer data to derive actionable insights for businesses.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
